subject: af-con
title: AF.CON.------TH.CON.
description: Chart on book p. 281 (CMOA(II)-39). AF-CON (affinity convergence) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names TH-CON; the chart has no label for it. From the subject: IF-SPI, TH-CONT (thrust continuance) and IST-P. From IF-SPI: INFO-INTR (information interpretation) and PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From IST-P: PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies). From PART: P-PC and AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) and TR-INFO (trans-information).
